title: 阿斯旺高壩
summary: 本課以以阿斯旺長期蓄水調節串連土石壩與尼羅河水量為主線，先用跨季庫容水量帳與大湖蒸發與面積界定水力與構造條件，再將核心沉陷與接觸、淤積量與乾密度連結到監測基線與異常。公開工程事實與假想算例分開；下列尺寸水量及材料參數均不是阿斯旺設計或操作資料。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops connecting Aswan long-term storage with embankment behavior and Nile water accounting through Seasonal reservoir water balance and Lake evaporation and surface area, then connects Core settlement and interfaces and Sediment storage and dry density to Monitoring baseline and anomaly. Public project facts are separate from hypothetical calculations; dimensions flows and material parameters below are not Aswan design or operating data. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查跨季庫容水量帳：InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3；再獨立檢查大湖蒸發與面積：HypotheticalArea=500 km2; evaporationDepth=1.8 m/year; lossVolume=500e6*1.8/1e9=0.90 km3/year。敏感度：同面積500km2下年蒸發深度由1.8增至2.1m，水量損失由0.90增至1.05km3，增加0.15km3；實際湖面積會隨水位變化，故需逐時或逐月積分。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。公開工程事實與假想算例分開；下列尺寸水量及材料參數均不是阿斯旺設計或操作資料。 將核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Seasonal reservoir water balance: InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3. Independently examine Lake evaporation and surface area: HypotheticalArea=500 km2; evaporationDepth=1.8 m/year; lossVolume=500e6*1.8/1e9=0.90 km3/year. Sensitivity: over a fixed500km2 surface, annual evaporation increasing from1.8 to2.1m changes loss from0.90 to1.05km3, an increase of0.15km3. Real surface area varies with stage and requires time integration. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Public project facts are separate from hypothetical calculations; dimensions flows and material parameters below are not Aswan design or operating data. Use the following independent check: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「跨季庫容水量帳」與「大湖蒸發與面積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seasonal reservoir water balance" and "Lake evaporation and surface area": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 跨季庫容水量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seasonal reservoir water balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「跨季庫容水量帳」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seasonal reservoir water balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 阿斯旺案例凸顯長期蓄水必須追蹤入流、放流與損失，單一洪峰並不能描述跨季可靠度。用共同時間窗更新庫存可檢查調節邏輯，但不能忽略水位面積與可用庫容限制；每個水量來源應保留獨立觀測與不確定度。 驗證時應以庫水位容量曲線交叉核對同期流量積分的庫存變化，並辨識以下失效情境：把所有水量殘差當蒸發會掩蓋量測或漏列放流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「跨季庫容水量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aswan provides context for long-term storage accounting beyond a single flood peak. Update storage from inflow, release and losses over a common window. This bookkeeping does not remove stage-area or usable-storage limits, and each component needs independent observations and uncertainty rather than one balancing adjustment. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Cross-check integrated flows against storage change from the stage-capacity curve. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assigning every residual to evaporation conceals measurement errors or omitted releases. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seasonal reservoir water balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只知道洪峰流量就能判定跨季供水可靠度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Peak flood discharge alone determines seasonal supply reliability" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「跨季庫容水量帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seasonal reservoir water balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 跨季庫容水量帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seasonal reservoir water balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨季庫容水量帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seasonal reservoir water balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以庫水位容量曲線交叉核對同期流量積分的庫存變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check integrated flows against storage change from the stage-capacity curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 跨季庫容水量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seasonal reservoir water balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨季庫容水量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seasonal reservoir water balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以庫水位容量曲線交叉核對同期流量積分的庫存變化。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把所有水量殘差當蒸發會掩蓋量測或漏列放流」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check integrated flows against storage change from the stage-capacity curve. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Assigning every residual to evaporation conceals measurement errors or omitted releases. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以庫水位容量曲線交叉核對同期流量積分的庫存變化作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把所有水量殘差當蒸發會掩蓋量測或漏列放流，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Cross-check integrated flows against storage change from the stage-capacity curve. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Assigning every residual to evaporation conceals measurement errors or omitted releases. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有水量殘差當蒸發會掩蓋量測或漏列放流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assigning every residual to evaporation conceals measurement errors or omitted releases. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 跨季庫容水量帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seasonal reservoir water balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨季庫容水量帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seasonal reservoir water balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有水量殘差當蒸發會掩蓋量測或漏列放流。診斷時應採取以下查核：以庫水位容量曲線交叉核對同期流量積分的庫存變化，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning every residual to evaporation conceals measurement errors or omitted releases. Diagnose it by the following check: Cross-check integrated flows against storage change from the stage-capacity curve. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只知道洪峰流量就能判定跨季供水可靠度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Peak flood discharge alone determines seasonal supply reliability" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「核心沉陷與接觸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core settlement and interfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相鄰沉陷差就必定等於核心裂縫寬度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Settlement difference necessarily equals the width of a core crack" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

steps.objective: 說明「發電淨水頭與出力」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Net head and power output” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型蓄水壩的發電能力由流量、淨水頭與效率共同控制，庫水位只是上游水頭的一部分。尾水上升與水路損失會降低淨落差，裝置容量也不等於任何時刻能達到的出力；應以一致工況的量測核對能量轉換。 驗證時應同步記錄上下游水位流量與機組功率並列水路損失，並辨識以下失效情境：只用壩高當發電水頭會高估可用能量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「發電淨水頭與出力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Power depends on flow, net head and efficiency. Reservoir level is only one upstream contribution; tailwater and conveyance losses reduce usable head. Installed capacity is not guaranteed output at every stage, so compare energy conversion using measurements from the same operating condition. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using dam height as generating head overstates usable energy. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Net head and power output” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「發電淨水頭與出力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Net head and power output”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
